games.note: Two of the top dogs in the Big Ten duel in Indiana this week. Both teams have some questions that only a win in a game like this can answer.
Both of these SEC squads got punched in the mouth last week. This is no longer a duel between national championship dreamers, this is a game for survival.
They're 26th and 27th in my poll. The winner has a good shot at the top 25 and a path back into CFP conversations. The loser will likely see any outside CFP shot snuffed out.
A classic rivalry in the best venue in CFB. Bama's loss to Georgia is only as bad as they make it mentally, but there's no harder place to bounce back from a tough loss than Neyland.
The Bulldogs are on top of the world once again, but they can't get too high on themselves. A desperate Auburn squad is looking to cause even more chaos.

Missouri is one of the 3 Musketeers of crazy risers (with UCLA and Wake). Transitive property says they should whoop Ole Miss, but let's be honest. Has transitive property ever worked in College Football?

A traditional CBB blue blood clash gets a little mid-October Saturday seasoning as Duke tries to redeem themselves after a bad loss to the Yellow Jackets. On the other side, Bill and the Tar Heels hope to keep their upswing from Pittsburgh going. Winner likely gets into strong ACC contention.
The Big 12's biggest risers duel in a city in need of some sports revitalization. Who's gonna make the step towards Texas Tech and Utah?
I do not think I have dogged on an undefeated team this late into the season like I have the Cougars. Can they prove me wrong and knock off the ever-so-confident Fighting Irish?

If you told me I would care about a UCLA vs Wisconsin game at the start of the season, I would have told you that you were insane. Now UCLA is a top 5 team and Wisconsin is a rather strong 4-1 team. Can UCLA hold the top of the Big Ten hill another week?
Both of these teams shocked the world last week. Which of these teams is empty hype and which is a true CFP contender?
Two top teams reeling from tough losses with a side of a potential revenge game against Raiola makes for the best after dark kickoff we have had in years.
